decision_scope: This finding audits NBA and NHL Nov10 outcomes; governing V2.5 Phase2 is NFL-specific and is not unlocked by this NBA/NHL audit.

stakeholders_status.NBA: NBA actual archived production 60/40 and two Bayesian shadows show favorable descriptive one-date matched Brier vs median sportsbook on abstention-filtered subsets; no promotion or reproducible edge yet
stakeholders_status.NHL: NHL actual production 60/40 and qualitative Engine B underperform median sportsbook on matched single-date contracts; prioritize root-cause and prospective shadow tests

verified_software_defect.name: NHL official final state OFF rejected by collector
verified_software_defect.prior_impact: all 106 original NHL SOG contracts falsely pending at morning audit
verified_software_defect.repair: NHL OFF and FINAL both treated as completed in schedule and provider boxscore; CRIT/LIVE rejected

independent_root_causes.name: Count variance and inaccurate mean/count distribution
independent_root_causes.evidence: Poisson exploratory Pearson dispersion NBA recent 2.267, NHL recent 1.889; excess variability may include mean/role errors, cannot infer NB2 alone solves.

independent_root_causes.name: Production differs by sport
independent_root_causes.evidence: NBA 60/40 consensus n146 Brier 0.239755 vs same-market 0.246562; NHL consensus n102 0.263987 vs 0.250399; NHL Engine B worse than matched market in 7/7 game clusters.

independent_root_causes.name: Misnamed peer shrinkage
independent_root_causes.evidence: pooled baseline uses all player historical games instead of last5 and prior player-comparable rate only 1.049% effective exposure at median, no verified position.

independent_root_causes.name: Missing genuine pregame opportunity/role factor distributions
independent_root_causes.evidence: frozen baseline uses last-five median workload; zero independently archived true four-factor pregame vectors; composite NBA components and team/player correlation not modeled.

independent_root_causes.name: Provider identity and source-level selection
independent_root_causes.evidence: one stale-team Dawson Mercer supplied by real pregame quote collector; 602 side rejects before scoring, selection coverage substantial.

independent_root_causes.name: Nonnegative support failure of current count Bayes likelihood
independent_root_causes.evidence: NBA 29 Bayesian A and 25 Bayesian B original eligible contracts abstained with normal_predictive_negative_mass.

independent_root_causes.name: Morning evaluation/display defect and incoherent online research sidecars
independent_root_causes.evidence: 624 paired original-first-batch morning contracts double-scored as sides, reporting tautological 50% probability and hit; all online Bayes A/B available complementary pair sums >1, unlike production Bayesian A/B.

independent_root_causes.name: Insufficient independent test dates and verified economic execution terms
independent_root_causes.evidence: one slate date, NBA5 games and NHL7, no operator-specific payout, multiple researched models and selection effects.

required_before_full_phase2: Complete any applicable NFL-specific prerequisite if requesting governing V2.5 Phase 2, not inferred from NBA/NHL evidence
Fix original pregame role/team authority and independently pin sources before feature generation and candidate selection
Correct one-contract-one-scored forecast morning report, keep source IDs, first-archive chronology and abstention coverage; reject noncomplementary online Bayes
Run at least several distinct new prospective calendar dates with official-sourced player-level final results and exact original quotes
Report paired, game/date-cluster uncertainty, source selection/abstention, signed directional residuals and multiple-testing controls
For NBA/NHL small trials, freeze selected count/support/distribution hypothesis, original cutoff and no re-use of Nov10 discovery outcomes as unseen test
Verify original eligible pickem payout and settlement contract for economic release claim
Do not remove frozen legacy production outputs or promote Tier1/Tier2 without independent performance power and calibrated uncertainty
